subject.title: fix(secrets): resolve active exec refs locally

question: Should active allowed exec SecretRefs resolve locally per path while every remaining path retains gateway snapshot ownership?
rationale: This determines the permanent process boundary for credential resolution and differs materially from the competing PR's whole-target gateway skip.

options.title: Adopt split per-path ownership
options.body: Land this PR so only successful active exec paths move local while mixed and failed paths remain gateway-owned.

options.title: Adopt whole-target local fallback
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96661 and skip the gateway for the command target set whenever an active exec ref exists.

recommendation.title: Adopt split per-path ownership
recommendation.body: Land this PR so only successful active exec paths move local while mixed and failed paths remain gateway-owned.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the relevant secret-resolution and gateway secret-handler boundary to this team.
